core.notes:
Tools: Cost Tables keeps the prices it opened with; pressing Sync brings the newer levels, and a level you typed stays until Reset inputs
Fixed: your village could be recorded as another player's (hovering someone else's village before yours was known) and kept for good; AWOO+ now only keeps a village name it knows is yours, and drops an old one it cannot confirm
Fixed: the daily diagnostics could file you under a party member's name; they now use only your own character's name
Daily diagnostics now also say when the game tab was loaded and which game server and game version it is on, so an update waiting on a reload can be told from one that never arrived
